# Tidemark

> Tidemark is a command-line tool that checks a static site for broken links, missing anchors and redirect chains before it is deployed.

## Docs

- [Install Tidemark](/docs/install.html)
- [Get started in five minutes](/docs/quickstart.html)
- [Write your first report](/docs/guides/first-report.html)
